newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb before holiday.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb before holiday.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.05 down at 42.05 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday because of a rise of demand for the U.S. currency before the year-end holiday, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open stable on Thursday owing to a lack of trading interest by major players.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 5.0 percent compared to Monday's close at 4.80 percent.
